title: Crew
description: A crew of the organisation's Belai library: a named set of worker agents a host runs together. A crew's display name is unique in the library; a document naming a crew nobody declared adopts it. Members name agent profiles by their name, as the console's crew editor does; whether each exists and is a worker is checked by the host when it installs the crew. Every apply that changes it saves a new version; deleting the document hides the crew and keeps its versions.

displayName.description: The crew's name in the library: one line of at most 128 characters, not starting belai:. Defaults to metadata.name.

description.description: One line of at most 500 characters.

members.description: The agents in the crew, 1 to 8.

profile.description: The name of an agent profile in the library (its front matter name).

replicas.description: How many copies of the agent run, 1 to 8. Left out, one.

onePerRepo.description: Run at most one copy of the crew per repository.
